label: Join root is the stage-two root; registered after a sense-link cleanup
summary: Question (modal spine, next investigation 3): is the ungrounded individual of the join (NecessaryConcreteUnderivedAt m w, STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-UNDERIVED-AT) the root the stage-two chain to NecessaryClassicalGodRootAt (STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT) starts from, without the regress premises? Finding: yes, under the stage-two premises. TruthCore.Results.Causality.NecessaryClassicalGodRootFromUnderived.derive composes UnderivedRootPerfection.derive, PerfectRootPositiveIntellectWill.derive and ClassicalGodFromPositiveRoot.derive on ONE signature carrier, model, world, q3 profile and predicate dictionary, from the underived individual, excluded middle and the 21 act/being, attribute and naming premises of NecessaryClassicalGodRoot.derive. It drops population (STMT-COGITO-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD), whole-roster nontrapping (STMT-WHOLE-ROSTER-NOT-TRAPPED) and contingent grounding (STMT-EVERY-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED-AT); those only produce the root. The join's all-world support exclusion is used only at w; uniqueness is among actual roots at w, not all necessary individuals. REGISTRATION (second step, same day): the first attempt was blocked by the sense-index gate. The repair applied one rule: where a statement links several senses of one disambiguated term, it keeps only the senses whose Lean declaration its bound type reaches (scripts/BindTypes.lean sense reachability on the theorem, checked by hand for structure types reached only through projections, such as Modal.Frame inside NecessaryAt). (1) STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT keeps NECESSARY_2 NecessaryAt, GOD_4 Signature.IsGod, MAXIMAL_1 IsMaximumIn and WELL_FOUNDEDNESS_AND_ANTI_BRUTE_ROOT_2 ActualRoot, and drops 14 definition links its type does not use: DEF-NECESSARY-PER-SE (NECESSARY_4), DEF-MODAL-FIXTURE-FRAME (NECESSARY_11; the frame occurs only inside NecessaryAt), DEF-GOD-NOMINAL-Q13 (GOD_1; the nominal description belongs to the naming premise), DEF-MAXIMUM-IN-A-PERFECTION (MAXIMAL_6, the IsMaximalIn alias for generic r), both CAUSE_OF_ESSE_VERSUS_SUFFICIENT_REASON senses (DEF-Q3A4-ESSENTIAL-PRINCIPLES-CAUSE-ESSE, DEF-Q3A4-EXTERNAL-ESSE-CAUSE-MODEL), both INTRINSIC_PRODUCTIVE_CONTRIBUTION senses (DEF-DERIVATIVE-JOINT-SUPPLY, DEF-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-EXISTENTIAL-SUPPLY), both NECESSITY_OF_ONE_INDIVIDUAL senses (DEF-NECESSARY-INDIVIDUAL-QUANTIFIERS de dicto, DEF-ROUTE-BRIDGE-MODAL-READING modalPossible), both NONNECESSARY_VERSUS_CONTINGENT_ROOT senses (DEF-NONNECESSARY-ROOT, DEF-KANT-MODAL-CONTINGENCY), DEF-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND-ANCESTRY (WELL_FOUNDEDNESS_1 GroundAncestor) and DEF-POTENCY (adopted POTENCY_1; InPotency is a free parameter). (2) STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-UNDERIVED-AT replaces DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT (WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_..._3) by DEF-KANT-ONTOLOGICAL-MODEL (sense 1, Ontic): its body quantifies over Profile.grounds and ExistsAt directly, never through PresentEsseSupport. This also resolves the earlier worry that the underived premise and the act-of-being bridges read m.grounds under two senses. (3) STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND replaces DEF-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND-ANCESTRY and DEF-BRUTE-ROOT-RELATIVE-GROUNDING (WELL_FOUNDEDNESS senses 1 and 2, neither used) by the undisambiguated ActualConcreteGround edge definition a1b2e330-388f-4120-bc5c-969642317792. Two conflicts were genuine and handled by existing records, not new bridges: GOD_1/GOD_4 through the naming premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE, which is the GOD_1 to GOD_4 bridge (declared in sense_bridges, as by the existing maxime-ens routes); and POTENCY, where STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY links adopted POTENCY_1 although the theorem's InPotency is free, while STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT links independent POTENCY_2 (#1278 audit). Relinking the shared act-priority record would change about 50 adopted and generic arguments, so, as in #1278, the registered theorem NecessaryClassicalGodRootFromUnderived.Registration.derive (own frozen Challenge) takes act priority through the transparent wrapper ClassicalAttributesLocalLogic.IndependentPriority (statement 3b2d2d46-baa6-4772-a2db-bb3daeb092fc, POTENCY_2) and delegates to the unchanged frozen composition. The registered result (listed under evidence) passes truth check, corpus.py check, bind-check (23 hypotheses bound), bundle_audit and verify-result (Comparator and NanoDa, no axioms). The cleanup made 13 legacy allowlist entries stale (NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT-FROM-MAXIMAL-TARGET-ASYMMETRY and ROOT-PERFECTION-FROM-WHOLE-POWER); they were removed and none was added. truth frontier-diff: no change (421 open premises reaching the root, 303 support alternatives), since the statement-level route already existed. No premise is established; J1, J2, F1 and the stage-one premises upstream of the underived individual stay open.
blocker: None for this registration. Remaining cleanup outside this result: the four older arguments to STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT keep legacy allowlist entries, because their intermediate statements (for example STMT-DIRECT-ESSE-ROOT-PERFECTION) and STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY (POTENCY_1 on a free InPotency parameter) still link several senses. Reopen if a reviewer judges that a removed link expressed a sense the endpoint's type does use.
